about_blocks.text: Addiction Treatment at Awakenings Health and Wellness Center
about_blocks.html: Addiction Treatment at Awakenings Health and Wellness Center

about_blocks.text: Awakenings Health and Wellness Center for Men is dedicated to providing effective addiction treatment to individuals struggling with various forms of addiction. We understand the complexity of addiction and the impact it can have on the lives of those affected and their families. Our team of dedicated treatment professionals works to guide our clients to confront addiction at its source, accept its limitations, and move forward to a healthy, sober life. We offer a safe, in-house environment that is inclusive and assists clients in effectively coping with everyday life situations and triggering behaviors. We take pride in providing holistic, judgment-free care from experienced and certified staff. Our guests are encouraged to help shape their recovery to fit into their post-stay lives.

about_blocks.text: In-House Programs at Awakenings Health and Wellness Center
about_blocks.html: In-House Programs at Awakenings Health and Wellness Center

about_blocks.text: Our in-house programs are designed to fit the individual needs of our clients. We offer a range of treatment options, including individual and group therapy sessions, behavioral therapy, cognitive-behavioral therapy, and more. Our team of professionals provides personalized care and support to help clients achieve their recovery goals. We also offer discharge planning to support the transition from structured treatment schedules to everyday life.

about_blocks.text: Awakenings Health and Wellness Centre - Center Overview
about_blocks.html: Awakenings Health and Wellness Centre - Center Overview

about_blocks.text: Awakenings Health and Wellness Centre is a men’s only facility designed to help individuals struggling with addiction confront their challenges and move towards a healthier lifestyle. The centre offers a safe and supportive environment with experienced and certified staff who provide holistic and judgement-free care. At Awakenings, each client receives a personalized program tailored to their unique needs and goals.

The centre offers a safe and supportive environment with experienced and certified staff who provide holistic and judgement-free care. At Awakenings, each client receives a personalized program tailored to their unique needs and goals.

about_blocks.text: The goal of Awakenings is to help individuals not only achieve sobriety but also effectively cope with triggers and challenges they may face in everyday life. The centre understands the complexity of addiction and its impact on families and loved ones, which is why they provide individualized discharge planning to support a smooth transition from structured treatment to everyday life. With the guidance and support of the Awakenings team and an inclusive community of peers, individuals can overcome addiction and make lasting positive changes to their lives.
